text:
Elaine: quick sync — we need a final decision for the retention + evidence export piece for the Q2 roadmap. Proposal: ship an MVP retention profile (90d hot + 1y cold exportable) for Dedicated/Private in Q2; offer hosted-metered cold exports as a Q3 pilot.

Sanjay: +1. Two-track makes sense. Most customers ask for 90/365/3y buckets; 7y is rare and should be handled via Extended on Dedicated/Private.

Maria: operational rule: any retention toggle that affects live retention must be restricted to Dedicated/Private. Hosted gets scheduled export jobs to cold storage (billed).

Kevin: implementation sketch: tenant-prefixed object layout + lifecycle policies. Exports produce a manifest with SHA256 and a signer field. Minimal manifest example (conceptual): {tenant, window_start, window_end, object_list, sha256, signer}.

Ariane: legal needs chain-of-custody: signed manifest, timestamped upload record, and platform key-rotation log. If customers demand BYOK, manifests must be verifiable with their key or we must provide a verifiable envelope.

Sanjay: BYOK signing options: 1) customer-sign-before-upload (customer-provided signature), 2) platform-sign-then-wrap-with-customer-public-key, 3) delegated short-lived signing via customer KMS (complex). Recommend option 2 for Dedicated/Private; option 1 acceptable where customer can push signatures.

OpsOncall: risk summary — longer retention inflates storage, index sizes, and backup surface. Require per-tenant retention quotas and alerts (75/90/100%). Exports should be rate-limited and scheduled off-peak.

Anya (UX): Console requirements: retention-profile selector (90d default), export scheduling UI, manifest download with verification instructions, and per-tenant cost estimate.

Elaine: MVP acceptance criteria: a) tenant queries by id+time range meet SLA for recent windows (95p <2s for <=30d); b) exports generate a downloadable signed manifest with integrity hash; c) Console shows retention state and scheduled exports; d) legal signoff on manifest format.

Action owners & dates: Sanjay — cost model for 90/365/3y by 2024-04-05; Kevin — manifest + signing spike by 2024-03-29 (include openssl verify examples and platform-wrap POC); Ops/Infra — quota/alerts design by 2024-04-05; Ariane — chain-of-custody signoff by 2024-03-27; Anya — Console mocks by 2024-03-31.

Elaine: plan to include this in the PM roadmap PR and schedule a 30-minute decision sync next week. Thumbs? :thumbsup:
